title: Primitive-to-modern technology pathways: P1-P3 pilot
claim_ceiling: Conceptual graph only. No edge establishes a local process recipe, cost, timeline, safety, or physical reproducibility.

rules.requires_all: Every listed prerequisite must be qualified.
rules.requires_any: At least one listed alternative must be qualified; alternatives do not inherit one another's evidence.
rules.external_tokens: Tokens prefixed or named as imported, salvaged, qualified, or locally demonstrated are explicit scenario assertions and need their own evidence in any real profile.
rules.unknown_prerequisite: Unknown or conflicting prerequisites block the stronger capability claim; never assume true.
rules.evidence: Evidence attaches to a specific claim under a specific profile, not to a technology name globally.
rules.history: Edges are dependency hypotheses, not a universal chronology. Alternative modern routes may leapfrog historical stages but cannot erase their own real dependencies.
rules.physical_authority: No graph result grants authority to allocate resources, purchase, energize equipment, manufacture products, or operate machinery.

evidence_tiers.E1: Credible historical account or specialist reference.
evidence_tiers.E2: Directly documented process with known conditions.
evidence_tiers.E4: Field demonstrated under a bounded local profile.
evidence_tiers.E5: Reproduced by a separately operated node using transferred knowledge and qualified inputs.

sources.author: Lewis Dartnell
sources.title: The Knowledge: How to Rebuild Our World from Scratch
sources.use: Orientation and bibliography seed across agriculture, materials, power, transport, communications, chemistry and scientific knowledge.
sources.limits: Not a validated field manual; technical claims and conditions require specialist verification.

sources.title: Connecting the Scientific and Industrial Revolutions: The Role of Practical Mathematics
sources.use: Research anchor for relationships between practical mathematics, precision measurement, instrument-making and machine tools.
sources.limits: Historical explanatory evidence; not direct qualification of a modern local production route.

sources.title: The development and use of machine tools in historical perspective
sources.use: Research anchor for machine-tool development, productivity and industrial organization.
sources.limits: Historical overview; does not specify local input, cost or feasibility.

sources.title: UNESCO: Traditional craftsmanship
sources.use: Guidance on transmission and community context of traditional craft skills.
sources.limits: Not a technical process specification; community consent and knowledge restrictions must be respected.

sources.title: UNESCO: Transmission
sources.use: Guidance on knowledge and skills transfer across generations.
sources.limits: Not a technical process specification; practitioners remain active knowledge holders.

nodes.label: Observation, counting, shared measures and recordkeeping
questions: Which local measures are repeatable and comparable?
Who maintains records and teaches the practice?

nodes.label: Local resource, tool, energy and skill census
questions: Are inventories observed or only reported?
Which seasonal, ecological and access constraints apply?

nodes.label: Manual tools, workholding and basic repair
questions: Which tools and materials are actually present?
Which tasks require unrepresented specialist skill?

nodes.label: Bounded material shaping, joining and transformation routes
questions: Which resource and material grades are verified?
What energy, waste and ecological limits apply?
Which routes are locally demonstrated?

nodes.label: Repeatable measurement and reference-artifact continuity
questions: What is the uncertainty of the reference?
How is it checked and renewed?
Which claims require external calibration?

nodes.label: Renewable cutting tools, jigs, fixtures and workholding
questions: What material properties and tolerances are required?
Can wear surfaces and cutting edges be renewed?

nodes.label: A bounded useful-work drive or power input
questions: Is the resource seasonal?
Are bearings, lubrication, structures and guards available?
Can operating limits be established?

nodes.label: Use of an available machine tool for a bounded task
questions: Is the actual machine operational and correctly configured?
What tasks, materials and limits are qualified?
What does not follow about maintenance or local reproduction?

nodes.label: Production with a stated, valid inspection basis
questions: Are measurement uncertainty and calibration current?
Are material identity, process revision and acceptance criteria traceable?

nodes.label: Locally reproduced machine-tool capability
questions: Which spindles, slides, bearings, motors and controls remain external?
Can the calibration and cutting-tool renewal chains also be maintained?

nodes.label: Use of an existing or locally demonstrated electrical supply
questions: Are protection, insulation, grounding, storage and load limits qualified?
Which supply and replacement dependencies remain external?

nodes.label: Local reproduction of selected electromechanical equipment
questions: Which conductors, insulation, magnetic materials, bearings, controls and test equipment are mandatory?
What electrical safety and qualification evidence is required?

nodes.label: Use of an available computer or communications module
questions: What power, storage, interface, language and maintenance constraints apply?
What remains usable without the network?

nodes.label: Diagnostics and repair of selected electronic assemblies
questions: What test equipment, schematics and skills are available?
Which components can actually be replaced and tested?
What protections are required?

nodes.label: Advanced semiconductor-device manufacturing: placeholder with unresolved critical dependencies
questions: Do not count this node as closed until each required dependency is modeled and qualified.

nodes.label: Versioned, duplicateable technical knowledge packet and training path
questions: Are diagrams, worked examples, units, revisions, failure modes, rights and training/assessment methods included?
Can the packet be used offline?

profiles.notes: Profile claims are fixture inputs; presence of tools, materials and skills must be justified for any real place.
Possession does not prove operation, maintenance, repair, replacement-part production or reproduction.
Selected modern modules can be used without a local historical reconstruction sequence; upstream repair and supply dependencies remain visible.

required_future_tests: Use of imported equipment must not imply local manufacture of that equipment.
A machine's operation and the conformity of its output are separate claims.
Removing a required prerequisite must block closure unless a qualified alternate path is available.
Unknown critical semiconductor dependencies keep N15 blocked.
All proposed nodes remain E0 until claim-specific evidence is admitted.
The independent verifier rejects missing dependency tokens and forged transition receipts.
